_about: Every faction a list in data.js may use, and where its rules are checked: the Wahapedia faction page (wahapedia.ru/wh40k11ed/factions/<waha>/), the BSData catalogue (by name), and GW's Faction Pack PDF when there is one (assets.warhammer-community.com/<file>); allies: the Wahapedia faction of each allied faction New Recruit names in a list's roster (“Allies: Legiones Daemonica”), whose datasheet pages an allied unit's wording comes from. fetch.sh, texts.js, bsdata.js and run.js read this file; verify/add-army.js adds to it.

pack.label: GW Printed Product Updates Adeptus Custodes

adeptus-custodes.note: GW's newest Adeptus Custodes document is the Printed Product Updates of 14 Oct 2026 for the new Codex: Adeptus Custodes; the Faction Pack 1.2 (eng_30-09_wh40k_faction_pack_adeptus_custodes-xlscee8b1b-b1evo9u920.pdf, 30 Sep 2026) is the previous codex's and is not used.

pack.label: GW Faction Pack Chaos Space Marines
GW Printed Product Updates Space Marines

ultramarines.note: Wahapedia's Space Marines page filtered to the Ultramarines Chapter (factions/space-marines/ultramarines) holds the army rules and every detachment an Ultramarines army can take (Deathwatch Support among them); its datasheet pages are under factions/space-marines/ (wahaDs), each with every Chapter's variant, of which the Ultramarines' is read (wahaChapter: the Chapter code of Wahapedia's filter). GW's newest Space Marines document is the Printed Product Updates 1.1 of 14 Oct 2026 (Codex: Space Marines). The Deathwatch Terminator Squad is the codex's (Wahapedia space-marines/Deathwatch-Terminator-Squad), not the Warhammer Legends one of GW's Imperial Agents Faction Pack. baseGuide: the sections of GW's base size guide (Event Companion) the list's units are in.
